title: Context Object Pattern — Companion Code
description: Runnable context-object demos in Python (frozen dataclass + replace), Java (immutable builder), and JavaScript (Object.freeze). Each shows a RequestContext built once at the boundary and passed through the service layer.
description_es: Demos ejecutables del patrón Context Object en Python (dataclass frozen + replace), Java (builder inmutable) y JavaScript (Object.freeze). Cada una muestra un RequestContext construido en el borde y pasado por la capa de servicio.
